description: A team manager must decide whether Mara will lead a high-visibility client-recovery sprint and finalize the assignment's workload, meeting schedule, and evidence record.

shared_context.S1: The Cedar client has entered a six-week recovery sprint after a difficult service disruption.
shared_context.S2: Mara has been proposed as the internal lead for the recovery sprint, but Elena makes the final assignment.
shared_context.S3: The lead will coordinate client updates, internal follow-ups, and a weekly cross-team review.
shared_context.S4: Elena's normal assignment-review checklist requires Jonah to formally disclose firsthand observations and Mara to formally disclose personal availability constraints before Elena records the assignment; Elena cites each disclosed item used in the final decision.

PF1.text: Jonah personally observed Mara lead exactly four incident-recovery huddles during the past quarter, including one with three departments, and saw her resolve conflicting ownership questions; he has not entered those observations in the team feedback system.

PF2.text: Mara has a standing caregiving commitment that limits her Cedar work to exactly 12 hours per week and makes Tuesday at 10:30 the only workable time for the recurring cross-team review; she expected to discuss this only if the nomination became official.

acceptance_conditions: Mara must be assigned as the Cedar recovery-sprint lead.
The assignment record must include exactly four relevant incident-recovery observations.
Mara's Cedar workload must be capped at exactly 12 hours per week.
The recurring cross-team review must be scheduled for Tuesday at 10:30.
Elena must explicitly cite the facts that support the assignment and its constraints.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The four firsthand recovery-huddle observations change the record from no specified evidence to exactly 4 observations and provide the concrete basis for assigning Mara as lead.
Mara's caregiving commitment changes the workload to exactly 12 hours per week and the recurring review to Tuesday at exactly 10:30.
